Dear Mark Lynn,

I am contacting you regarding AMASS BRANDS's (AMSS • CIK: 1851491) presentation at the Maxim Growth Conference.

Would 15 minutes be convenient this week for a confidential conversation under standard NDA?

Sincerely,
Eric Miller
